description: BRACE-RW E0 variance gate: measure Var_a[Q0(s,a)] under the frozen DP policy before any weighted training. Gate decides whether return-weighted fine-tuning (w=(1+cG)/(1+cV)) has a detectable exact local improvement Delta_c = c*Var_a[Q0]/(1+c*V0).

e0_variance_gate.rollout_dir_note: traced corpus: experiments/brace/rollouts_traced_base200_v2 (100 rollout_train seeds x 8 rollouts; only mixed-outcome seeds yield branch points, ~32 expected per inventory_traced_rollouts.py)
e0_variance_gate.seed_independence: continuation seeds are derived per (task, env_seed, snapshot_id, action_index, continuation_index) via SHA-256; no common random numbers across actions, which would bias S2_between downward or upward
e0_variance_gate.budget_note: 32 mixed seeds x 3 points x 8 actions x 2 continuations = 1536 rollouts per task

gate.decision: PASS requires BOTH pooled mean Delta_hat_{c=3} >= 0.02 AND Tarone one-sided overdispersion p <= 0.05. PASS -> proceed to BRACE-RW training arms (B1'/B3'). FAIL -> Var_a[Q0] is too small for return weighting to matter at this snapshot; switch direction per BRACE_RW_PLAN.md section 'direction switch'.

estimator.sigma2_Q: S2_between - S2_within / R (one-way random-effects ANOVA, unbiased for Var_a[Q])
estimator.confirmatory: Tarone (1979) exact-moment Z test for extra-binomial variation, pooled over branch points with 0 < pooled p_hat < 1
